sentence: A group guessing game where everyone bets whether the next shared household expense is higher or lower than the one shown, and the first to get five right in a row wins.
use_when: The group wants a quick guessing game to pass time together
Roommates want a playful game based on shared bills and costs
Someone wants a friendly contest with a small prize like boba
The chat wants a game where everyone plays at once, not in turns
dont_use_when: The group needs to split a bill or track who owes what
Two people want a head-to-head board or strategy game
The group needs to vote on a decision or collect opinions
